message: This is an invalid node selection. Ask the user to select a node from a visible page on the canvas.

The provided node ID was not found in the file. The node may have been deleted, or the ID was extracted incorrectly. Verify the node ID against the URL — for example, https://figma.com/design/:fileKey/:fileName?node-id=1-2 maps to nodeId `1:2`. If the ID looks right, ask the user to confirm the node still exists in the file.
